sentences.text: This animal belongs to the sphenosuchians, a group of early relatives to modern crocodiles.
The skull of the main specimen measures at least 60 centimeters long.
It holds the title of the biggest crocodylomorph discovered from the Triassic era.
Its upper jaw featured two unusually large teeth located at the fourth and fifth positions.
Scientists named the genus in 2005, choosing a species name that honors Quay County.
The creature possessed strong shoulder bones.
Experts suggest it acted as a major land predator after rauisuchians died out.
This animal lived during the Norian stage, between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago.
